originalSource.verification: Original source parsed by maintained integration owner using original parseCSV; receipt13October2026. This catalog does not rewrite those rows.

boundsAndCensoring.provenance: Conservative application rules, not a replacement agency assessment methodology.
boundsAndCensoring.source: Preserve source_value_token, bound value/unit/type, result detection condition, result status, qualifier, reporting limit and raw row.
boundsAndCensoring.exact: Use the original positive exact numeric result for geometric means only when no source qualifier contradicts exactness.
boundsAndCensoring.bounds: For strict threshold exceedance x>T, classify as certain above only if every possible value allowed by the original interval exceeds T; certain not above only if every allowed value is <=T; otherwise indeterminate. Preserve open/closed bounds.
boundsAndCensoring.gm: Do not silently discard censored, zero, negative or missing selected samples. The exact geometric-mean comparison is unsupported if any included sample is not a strictly positive exact value; a separately labelled descriptive eligible subset may be shown with its exclusions.
boundsAndCensoring.fraction: Retain every otherwise eligible sampled result in the denominator. Report [certain_exceedances/N,(certain_exceedances+indeterminate)/N]; compare to the allowed fraction only when this interval establishes a conclusion. Zero denominator is unsupported.
boundsAndCensoring.unqualifiedDetection: NotDetected needs an actual bound before quantitative use; NotReported is missing; Present Below/Above Quantification Limit is not an exact result merely because a numeric cell exists.

unobservedParameters.status: Profiles available for appropriate actual measured source records; no such records are asserted to exist in the730 E.coli source.

inputPolicy: Retain original cells, qualify interpretations and log explicit operator corrections; never mutate the source to force a profile match.
